text: Setting clear goals is the foundation of any successful project. To be effective, goals should be SMART: Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. Once you have a smart goal, break it down into smaller milestones. These are checkpoints that help you track progress and stay motivated. Each milestone should lead to a clear deliverable, such as a report, a prototype, or a finished section of work. Crucially, you must ensure stakeholder alignment from the start. This means regularly communicating with everyone involved—clients, team members, and managers—to confirm that the goals and milestones match their expectations. This prevents confusion and keeps the entire project moving in the same direction.
